## Setup

```{r}
#| eval: true
#| output: false
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Show setup code"

librarian::shelf(tidyverse, here, brms, tidybayes, arrow)

# shared with 03 and 05: species linpreds, subadult - adult contrasts, f_draw_agg summaries
source(here("size_bd_unified", "contrast_functions.R"))

cutoffs = c("co0", "co30", "co100", "co300", "co1000")

model_dir = here("size_bd_unified", "unified_models")
cache_dir = here("size_bd_unified", "intermediates", "th_sensitivity_analysis")

```

## Compute contrasts per cutoff

Compare species contrast estimates across Bd load cutoffs (copies per swab). The cutoff
used in the main analysis (co100) is chosen a priori; the others are a sensitivity analysis.
Cutoff models are not compared by LOO, since each cutoff changes the response data.
Contrasts are computed here from each cutoff model with the same code as 03
(contrast_functions.R). Models are loaded one at a time (~850 MB each); the per-cutoff
summaries are cached to intermediates/th_sensitivity_analysis/ so the models only need to be
loaded again when a model file changes.

```{r}
if (!dir.exists(cache_dir)) dir.create(cache_dir, recursive = TRUE)

# latest m11g fit per cutoff (file names end in _YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_with_loo.rds)
model_files = tibble(file = list.files(model_dir, pattern = "^unified_model_results_zln_m11g_co[0-9]+_.*_with_loo\\.rds$")) %>%
  mutate(cutoff = str_extract(file, "co[0-9]+")) %>%
  filter(cutoff %in% cutoffs) %>%
  group_by(cutoff) %>%
  slice_max(file, n = 1) %>%
  ungroup()

model_files

missing_cutoffs = setdiff(cutoffs, model_files$cutoff)
if (length(missing_cutoffs) > 0) {
  stop("No model file for cutoff(s): ", paste(missing_cutoffs, collapse = ", "))
}

# contrasts for one cutoff, cached by model file name
f_cutoff_contrasts = function(co, file) {
  cache_file = file.path(cache_dir, paste0("combined_agg_", sub("\\.rds$", "", file), ".csv"))

  if (file.exists(cache_file)) {
    return(read_csv(cache_file, show_col_types = FALSE))
  }

  model = readRDS(file.path(model_dir, file))
  stopifnot(model_response(model) == paste0("bd_load_", co, "_density"))

  combined_agg = spp_contrasts(model)$combined_agg
  rm(model)
  gc()

  write_csv(combined_agg, cache_file)
  combined_agg
}

th_combined = map2_dfr(model_files$cutoff, model_files$file, function(co, file) {
  f_cutoff_contrasts(co, file) %>%
    mutate(threshold = co)
}) %>%
  mutate(threshold = factor(threshold, levels = cutoffs))

```

## Reshape

Pivot each contrast's median/50%/95% interval columns into a common long format
so each can be plotted as a boxplot summary (box = 50% CI, whiskers = 95% CI,
midline = median).

```{r}
param_prefixes = c("hu_contrast", "mu_contrast")

th_long = map_dfr(param_prefixes, function(p) {
  th_combined %>%
    select(taxon_capture, threshold, contrast,
           lower_95 = paste0(p, "_lower_95"),
           lower_50 = paste0(p, "_lower_50"),
           median = paste0(p, "_median"),
           upper_50 = paste0(p, "_upper_50"),
           upper_95 = paste0(p, "_upper_95"),
           net_effect = paste0(p, "_net_effect"),
           support = paste0(p, "_support")) %>%
    mutate(parameter = p)
}) %>%
  filter(!is.na(median))  # species without an estimable mu contrast

```

## Agreement across cutoffs

Per species and contrast: does the direction (sign of the median) or support class
change across cutoffs?

```{r}
th_agreement = th_long %>%
  group_by(parameter, taxon_capture) %>%
  summarise(n_cutoffs = n(),
            sign_agrees = n_distinct(sign(median)) == 1,
            support_agrees = n_distinct(support) == 1,
            direction_by_cutoff = paste(if_else(median > 0, "+", "-"), collapse = " "),
            support_by_cutoff = paste(support, collapse = " / "),
            net_effect_by_cutoff = paste(round(net_effect, 2), collapse = " / "),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(parameter, sign_agrees, support_agrees, taxon_capture)

th_agreement

th_agreement %>%
  group_by(parameter) %>%
  summarise(n_species = n(),
            n_sign_agrees = sum(sign_agrees),
            n_support_agrees = sum(support_agrees),
            .groups = "drop")

```

## Boxplot comparison by species

```{r}
#| fig.height: 8
#| fig.width: 10

plot_th_comparison = function(param) {
  th_long %>%
    filter(parameter == param) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = threshold, fill = threshold)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "#555") +
    geom_boxplot(aes(ymin = lower_95, lower = lower_50, middle = median,
                      upper = upper_50, ymax = upper_95),
                 stat = "identity") +
    facet_wrap("taxon_capture", scales = "free_y") +
    labs(title = param, y = param, x = "cutoff") +
    theme_minimal()
}

```

```{r}
#| fig.height: 16
#| fig.width: 12
plot_th_comparison("hu_contrast")

```

```{r}

plot_th_comparison("mu_contrast")
```

## Naive (raw data) sensitivity to the cutoff

Model-free check of how the cutoff alone moves the raw summaries. The cutoff is swept over a
log grid of ITS1 copies per swab from 10 to 1000, centered on the main cutoff (100), with
co30 and co300 added so the fitted cutoffs appear on the grid. Swabs below the cutoff count as
negative, as in 00_survey_data.Rmd (`bd_load_coX = 0` if `bd_its_copies < X`). At each cutoff,
per species x life stage:

- prevalence: share of swabs at or above the cutoff, also on the logit scale (empirical logit,
  log((n_pos + 0.5) / (n - n_pos + 0.5)), finite at 0% and 100%), where a given change means
  the same for low- and high-prevalence species
- load: median log(copies / SVL) among positives, the same scale as the model's mu
  (`bd_load_coX_density`)

Uncertainty comes from resampling individuals within species x life stage (nonparametric
bootstrap). The same resamples give the subadult - adult difference (paired by replicate) and
the change relative to co100 (each replicate minus its own value at 100), so the intervals
show how much a summary moves with the cutoff, not just how uncertain it is at each cutoff.
Note the sign: prevalence is 1 - hu, so a positive naive prevalence difference corresponds
to a negative model hu_contrast.

```{r}
# same data as the m11g cutoff fits
load(here("size_bd_unified", "intermediates", "bd_model_env_unified_2026-11-12.RData"))
naive_data_tag = "2026-11-12"

# log grid, 12 steps per decade from 10 to 1000 (contains 100 exactly), plus co30 and co300
th_ref = 100
th_grid = sort(unique(c(th_ref * 10^(seq(-12, 12) / 12), 30, 300)))

n_boot = 500
min_pos = 3              # fewest positives for a median load (else NA)
min_valid_share = 0.9    # report an interval only if this share of replicates is estimable
y_lim_width = 0.5        # shared y-axes cover every species' central y_lim_width bootstrap
                         # interval (0.5 = the 50% bands); wider ribbons are clipped, not dropped

naive_data = brms_data %>%
  transmute(taxon_capture = as.character(taxon_capture),
            life_stage_simple = as.character(life_stage_simple),
            copies = bd_its_copies,
            log_density = log(bd_its_copies / svl_mm))

# prevalence and median positive load at every cutoff, for one resample
naive_summaries = function(x, ld) {
  tibble(threshold = th_grid,
         n_pos = vapply(th_grid, function(th) sum(x >= th), integer(1)),
         prevalence = n_pos / length(x),
         load = vapply(th_grid, function(th) {
           l = ld[x >= th]
           if (length(l) >= min_pos) median(l) else NA_real_
         }, numeric(1)))
}

# replicate 0 is the observed data, 1..n_boot are resamples of individuals
naive_group_boot = function(copies, log_density) {
  n = length(copies)
  map_dfr(0:n_boot, function(b) {
    idx = if (b == 0) seq_len(n) else sample.int(n, n, replace = TRUE)
    naive_summaries(copies[idx], log_density[idx]) %>%
      mutate(boot = b)
  })
}

naive_cache = file.path(cache_dir, paste0("naive_boot_", naive_data_tag, "_B", n_boot, ".rds"))

if (file.exists(naive_cache)) {
  naive_boot = readRDS(naive_cache)
} else {
  set.seed(2026)
  naive_boot = naive_data %>%
    group_by(taxon_capture, life_stage_simple) %>%
    group_modify(~naive_group_boot(.x$copies, .x$log_density)) %>%
    ungroup()
  saveRDS(naive_boot, naive_cache)
}

```

### Reshape and summarise

```{r}
# group sizes (each resample has the same n as its group), for the empirical logit
naive_n = naive_data %>%
  count(taxon_capture, life_stage_simple, name = "n")

# long: one row per species x stage x replicate x cutoff x metric
naive_long = naive_boot %>%
  left_join(naive_n, by = c("taxon_capture", "life_stage_simple")) %>%
  mutate(prevalence_logit = qlogis((n_pos + 0.5) / (n + 1))) %>%
  select(-n) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(prevalence, prevalence_logit, load), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(taxon_capture, life_stage_simple, boot, metric) %>%
  mutate(value_centered = value - value[threshold == th_ref]) %>%
  ungroup()

# subadult - adult difference, paired by replicate
naive_diff = naive_long %>%
  select(taxon_capture, life_stage_simple, boot, threshold, metric, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = life_stage_simple, values_from = value) %>%
  mutate(value = subadult - adult) %>%
  select(-adult, -subadult) %>%
  group_by(taxon_capture, boot, metric) %>%
  mutate(value_centered = value - value[threshold == th_ref]) %>%
  ungroup()

# observed value (replicate 0) and bootstrap median / 50% / 95% intervals, plus the central
# y_lim_width interval (lim_lower, lim_upper) used to set shared y-axis limits.
# intervals are NA where too few replicates are estimable (few positives at high cutoffs)
summarise_naive = function(df, value_col, group_cols) {
  df %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(c(group_cols, "threshold", "metric")))) %>%
    summarise(observed = .data[[value_col]][boot == 0],
              valid_share = mean(!is.na(.data[[value_col]][boot > 0])),
              median = median(.data[[value_col]][boot > 0], na.rm = TRUE),
              lower_95 = quantile(.data[[value_col]][boot > 0], 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
              lower_50 = quantile(.data[[value_col]][boot > 0], 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
              upper_50 = quantile(.data[[value_col]][boot > 0], 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
              upper_95 = quantile(.data[[value_col]][boot > 0], 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
              lim_lower = quantile(.data[[value_col]][boot > 0], (1 - y_lim_width) / 2, na.rm = TRUE),
              lim_upper = quantile(.data[[value_col]][boot > 0], (1 + y_lim_width) / 2, na.rm = TRUE),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(across(c(median, lower_95, lower_50, upper_50, upper_95, lim_lower, lim_upper),
                  ~if_else(valid_share >= min_valid_share, .x, NA_real_)))
}

stage_cols = c("taxon_capture", "life_stage_simple")

naive_stage_agg = summarise_naive(naive_long, "value", stage_cols)
naive_stage_centered_agg = summarise_naive(naive_long, "value_centered", stage_cols)
naive_diff_agg = summarise_naive(naive_diff, "value", "taxon_capture")
naive_diff_centered_agg = summarise_naive(naive_diff, "value_centered", "taxon_capture")

```

### Life-stage difference at the fitted cutoffs

Subadult - adult difference at co30, co100 and co300, and whether the sign of the observed
difference holds over the cutoffs where it is estimable (th_range_estimable). Species with no
estimable difference at any cutoff are left out.

```{r}
naive_diff_table = naive_diff_agg %>%
  group_by(metric, taxon_capture) %>%
  filter(!is.na(observed)) %>%
  summarise(sign_agrees_grid = n_distinct(sign(observed)) == 1,
            th_range_estimable = paste(signif(range(threshold), 3), collapse = "-"),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(naive_diff_agg %>%
              filter(threshold %in% c(30, 100, 300)) %>%
              # observed [95% interval]; interval omitted where too few replicates are estimable
              mutate(est = case_when(is.na(observed) ~ NA_character_,
                                     is.na(lower_95) ~ sprintf("%.2f", observed),
                                     .default = sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", observed, lower_95, upper_95))) %>%
              select(metric, taxon_capture, threshold, est) %>%
              pivot_wider(names_from = threshold, names_prefix = "co", values_from = est),
            by = c("metric", "taxon_capture")) %>%
  arrange(metric, sign_agrees_grid, taxon_capture)

naive_diff_table

naive_diff_table %>%
  group_by(metric) %>%
  summarise(n_species_estimable = n(),
            n_sign_agrees_grid = sum(sign_agrees_grid),
            .groups = "drop")

```

### Plots

Lines are the bootstrap median, ribbons the 50% and 95% intervals; the dashed line marks the
main cutoff (100).

Y-axes are shared across species wherever the values are comparable: all change-from-co100
plots and the absolute prevalence plots. There the axis spans every species' median and central
`y_lim_width` interval; wider ribbons (species with few positives) are clipped at the panel
edge. Absolute load and absolute subadult - adult differences keep free axes, since species
differ by several log units in level and those plots are about each curve's shape.

```{r}
naive_metric_labels = c(prevalence = "prevalence",
                        prevalence_logit = "logit prevalence",
                        load = "median log(copies / SVL) | positive")
naive_metric_titles = c(prevalence = "prevalence",
                        prevalence_logit = "logit prevalence",
                        load = "load")

# by_stage: colour by life stage; otherwise one series (the subadult - adult difference).
# scales = "fixed" shares the y-axis, limited to the medians and central y_lim_width intervals
plot_naive = function(agg, metric_name, y_lab, by_stage = TRUE, zero_line = FALSE,
                      scales = c("fixed", "free_y")) {
  scales = match.arg(scales)

  # drop species with nothing estimable (e.g. too few positives for a load median)
  d = agg %>%
    filter(metric == metric_name) %>%
    group_by(taxon_capture) %>%
    filter(any(!is.na(median))) %>%
    ungroup()

  p = if (by_stage) {
    ggplot(d, aes(x = threshold, y = median, color = life_stage_simple, fill = life_stage_simple))
  } else {
    ggplot(d, aes(x = threshold, y = median))
  }

  y_limits = if (scales == "fixed") {
    range(c(d$median, d$lim_lower, d$lim_upper, if (zero_line) 0), na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    NULL
  }

  p +
    (if (zero_line) geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "#555")) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = th_ref, linetype = "dashed", color = "#888") +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower_95, ymax = upper_95), alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower_50, ymax = upper_50), alpha = 0.35, color = NA) +
    geom_line() +
    scale_x_log10(breaks = c(10, 30, 100, 300, 1000)) +
    facet_wrap("taxon_capture", scales = scales, ncol = 6) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = y_limits) +
    labs(x = "cutoff (ITS1 copies per swab)", y = y_lab) +
    (if (by_stage) labs(color = "life stage", fill = "life stage")) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "top")
}

```

#### By life stage

```{r}
#| fig.height: 18
#| fig.width: 14
for (m in names(naive_metric_labels)) {
  print(plot_naive(naive_stage_agg, m, naive_metric_labels[[m]],
                   scales = if (m == "load") "free_y" else "fixed") +
          labs(title = paste("Naive", naive_metric_titles[[m]], "by cutoff")))

  print(plot_naive(naive_stage_centered_agg, m,
                   paste("change in", naive_metric_labels[[m]], "from co100"),
                   zero_line = TRUE, scales = "fixed") +
          labs(title = paste("Naive", naive_metric_titles[[m]], "by cutoff: change from co100")))
}

```

#### Subadult - adult difference

```{r}
#| fig.height: 18
#| fig.width: 14
for (m in names(naive_metric_labels)) {
  print(plot_naive(naive_diff_agg, m, paste("subadult - adult", naive_metric_labels[[m]]),
                   by_stage = FALSE, zero_line = TRUE, scales = "free_y") +
          labs(title = paste("Naive subadult - adult", naive_metric_titles[[m]], "difference by cutoff")))

  print(plot_naive(naive_diff_centered_agg, m,
                   paste("change in subadult - adult", naive_metric_labels[[m]], "from co100"),
                   by_stage = FALSE, zero_line = TRUE, scales = "fixed") +
          labs(title = paste("Naive subadult - adult", naive_metric_titles[[m]],
                             "difference: change from co100")))
}

```

### Export to manuscript

Everything needed to redraw the naive plots, in one long table. Each row is a cutoff x
metric x species (x life stage for `comparison == "stage"`); `scale` is "absolute" or
"centered" (change from co100). `life_stage_simple` is NA for the subadult - adult
differences. lim_lower / lim_upper are the central `y_lim_width` interval used for the shared
y-axis limits, and `th_ref` / `y_lim_width` are stored as columns so the plot settings travel
with the data.

```{r}
repo_dir = gsub("size_bd_load_analysis", "", here())
manuscript_data_dir = paste0(repo_dir, "size-bd-dynamics-manuscript/resources/01_essential_data/")

naive_agg_export = bind_rows(
  naive_stage_agg %>% mutate(comparison = "stage", scale = "absolute"),
  naive_stage_centered_agg %>% mutate(comparison = "stage", scale = "centered"),
  naive_diff_agg %>% mutate(comparison = "subadult - adult", scale = "absolute"),
  naive_diff_centered_agg %>% mutate(comparison = "subadult - adult", scale = "centered")) %>%
  mutate(th_ref = th_ref,
         y_lim_width = y_lim_width,
         n_boot = n_boot) %>%
  select(comparison, scale, metric, taxon_capture, life_stage_simple, threshold,
         observed, valid_share, median, lower_95, lower_50, upper_50, upper_95,
         lim_lower, lim_upper, th_ref, y_lim_width, n_boot)

write_parquet(naive_agg_export, paste0(manuscript_data_dir, "unified_th_a_naive_cutoff_agg.parquet"))
write_csv(naive_diff_table, paste0(manuscript_data_dir, "unified_th_b_naive_diff_table.csv"))

```
